audience: help center managers and writers who maintain knowledge base articles in Document360

useCases.title: Browse the articles of a workspace
useCases.text: List the projects and workspaces you can access, then list the articles of one workspace with their status and version.

useCases.title: Search the knowledge base for an answer
useCases.text: Search one workspace with the knowledge base search, not AI search. Open a result to read its content and version.

useCases.title: Draft a new article in a category
useCases.text: Find the category, then create the article as a draft. Readers do not see a draft until someone publishes it.

useCases.title: Edit and publish an article
useCases.text: Read the article and its version number. Edit it; a published article changes through a new draft by default. Publish the draft so readers see it.
